notes: v1.14.590 - THE HANDOFF READINESS GATE REQUIRES A CURRENT-DEPLOYMENT HANDOFF. External principal-engineer review of .589, Finding 3, P1.  WHAT A TECHNICIAN SEES: Command’s shift-readiness card no longer reports Handoff started as OK unless a handoff exists for the deployment on screen, saved within the last 12 hours. Everything else on that card is unchanged.  THE DEFECT. The gate read !!(hraw && JSON.parse(hraw)) over the raw phantom_handoff_v1 value. Any parseable JSON is truthy there, and JSON.parse of an empty array is an empty array, which is truthy. So an empty list, a handoff belonging to a DIFFERENT deployment, and a handoff saved months ago all read as a PASS - and with the other gates met the card printed clear to hand off having measured nothing. Third confirmed member of the displayed-state-stronger-than-measured-state family, after the blockers cell (.579) and the ungated cs-kpi-pct (queued).  WHAT THE STORE ACTUALLY HOLDS, because the gate label implies otherwise. handoff_generate returns a draft into an in-memory variable and writes nothing; the only writer of a record is handoff_saveRecord, which sets status saved and savedAt before it unshifts. The key therefore holds COMPLETED handoffs only, for every deployment, forever - nothing purges it at shift end and it has no cap. Any value here was never the right question.  THE PREDICATE. handoff_isCurrentFor reads through handoff_loadAll and safeGet, so a malformed blob is quarantined and returns an empty array: the gate stays OPEN, never throws, never passes. Records are filtered to the active deployment BY IDENTIFIER, never by position. Freshness prefers savedAt and falls back to generatedAt, checked with typeof and isFinite rather than a logical-or because a legitimate 0 is falsy - and a record carrying neither stamp never satisfies the gate, since absence is not a pass.  ONE WINDOW, NOT TWO. handoff_generate built its 12-hour summary from a function-local constant. The gate must measure the SAME period or the gate and the artifact it gates disagree, so the constant was lifted to a shared HANDOFF_WINDOW_MS with the identical value. DEVIATION REPORTED: the fix spec says do not touch the 12-hour summary builder, and this changed one line inside it. No behaviour change - the alternative was two declarations of one number that must be kept equal.  SCOPE DELIBERATELY NARROWED, AND THAT IS THE JUDGEMENT CALL. Phase 0 found SIX consumers of the shared handoffDraft boolean, not one, and three of them make an assertive claim rather than a gate reading - a handoff draft is open, finish it before shift end. Correcting the shared boolean would have made those three MORE precisely wrong: they would fire exactly when a technician had just saved a handoff for the current deployment. Their wrongness is pre-existing, because the store has only ever held saved handoffs. So only the gate moved. cs_renderReady already receives activeDep, so it answers its own question with no signature change and no call site moved. The now-unused handoffDraft parameter is left in place with an inline comment saying why, so nobody re-wires the row back to it.  FALSE WITH NO DEPLOYMENT IS CORRECT AND UNCHANGED. .577 ruled on exactly that for this row: the shift genuinely has not been handed off, so false is honest here where the null used by the blockers gate is not.  PINNED by test/e2e/63-handoff-readiness-gate.spec.js - 5 tests on phone-webkit, the primary field-device project. 4 RED against .589, GREEN with the fix: empty list, foreign deployment, stale record, and fresh-then-switch-deployment. The fifth (malformed JSON) passed before the fix too and is stated as a regression guard, not counted as a defect proof. Every case asserts the DOT colour as well as the text, because .577 passed its text assertions while the dot still rendered OK green.  REGRESSION: 98-cmd-census 27/27, 04-storage 20 passed 1 skipped standalone. Phase 0 predicted 98-cmd-census:185 would need its seed updated; under the narrower fix shape it did not, and that prediction is corrected in the evidence doc rather than left standing.  NOT IN THIS SHIP, and logged as findings: the three assertive surfaces above, the HANDOFF WAITING banner which filters saved with no deployment and no time filter, the dead status unread field, and the absence of any cap or shift-end purge on the handoff key.  DEVICE VERIFY OWED: on Command, with no handoff saved for the deployment on screen, the readiness card must read Handoff started OPEN with a gold dot - not OK and not a green dot.
